2–4 hours for the comb + the time to collect the items for the 2nd addon

The addons of the {wiki:Oriental Outfits|Oriental Outfits} are obtained in Darashia. The first (Scimitar for men, Jewelled Belt for women) requires you to fetch a {item:Coral Comb} from the dangerous waters of Calassa. The second (Turban for men, Veil for women) is a swap: you hand over 100 {item:Ape Fur}, 100 {item:Fish Fin|Fish Fins}, 2 {item:Enchanted Chicken Wing|Enchanted Chicken Wings} and 100 {item:Blue Piece of Cloth|Blue Pieces of Cloth}.
This comfortable, elegant outfit creates the romantic atmosphere of the Arabian Nights. Good places to look for the addons are, naturally, Darama and Ankrahmun.
**Premium** account (the base outfit is available to any Premium player; this quest only gives the addons).
Addon 1: **Relic Hunter** rank in the {wiki:Tibian Explorer Society|Explorer Society} (to travel to Calassa).
Addon 1: {wiki:Eleonore Quest|Eleonore Quest} completed, so you can go to Meriana and talk to {npc:Marina}.
Oriental Outfits addon 1: Scimitar (male) / Jewelled Belt (female)
Gather all the items for the second addon **before** talking to Razan/Miraia: you save trips.
In Calassa, a sorcerer or druid with strong area spells ({spell:Rage of the Skies}, {spell:Wrath of Nature}) helps a lot against the groups of Quaras.
Instead of going to Calassa you can buy the {item:Coral Comb} from another player.
You need a {item:Coral Comb} (the mermaid's comb), which is in a sealed room in Calassa.

Travel to **Darashia**: by boat (for example from Venore, {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes} to the harbour captain) you arrive next to {npc:Petros}; by {wiki:Magic Carpet|magic carpet} (Edron, Kazordoon, Svargrond, Femor Hills, Farmine or Issavi: {key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}) you arrive at the Darashia carpet. Habdel, Ishina, Razan and Miraia are all in the city.

If your character is **male**, go to {npc:Habdel}'s weapon shop in Darashia. Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. He makes you the scimitar if you get him a mermaid comb to give to Ishina.
Oriental male with the first addon (scimitar)
If your character is **female**, talk to {npc:Ishina} in Darashia and ask her about the {key:outfit}. She makes you a belt if you first bring her a {item:Coral Comb}.
Oriental female with the first addon (jewelled belt)
Check in the quest log that the mission was properly accepted. If not, you can't enter the Coral Comb room.

Travel to **Meriana**: go to **Liberty Bay** (from Darashia, {npc:Petros}'s boat: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}), go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg} and {key:yes} (50 gp). You arrive at Sabrehaven; the mermaid {npc:Marina} is by the **north** coast of the island. Talk to her. Say {key:hi} and {key:comb}: she lost her favourite comb while diving in Calassa.
To go back to **Liberty Bay**, go to {npc:Sebastian}, **south** of Sabrehaven, and say {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes} (50 gp).

Go to **Liberty Bay** and talk to {npc:Captain Max}, on the boat **east** of the main boat. Say {key:Calassa} to travel. The trip costs 200 gp. If you don't have a {item:Helmet of the Deep}, he rents you one (5000 gp deposit). In Calassa, equip the helmet and jump overboard (leave the platform to the **south**): you fall to the sea floor.
Prepare well: the way to the treasure room is very hard.
Where you land on the seabed

Equip the {item:Helmet of the Deep}, enter the water and go **east** to this point. Watch out for the {creature:Massive Water Elemental|Massive Water Elementals} and all kinds of Quaras, including {creature:Thul}.
Route in Calassa to the comb room
Go up the stairs and kill all the Quaras in the room. A sorcerer or druid with {spell:Rage of the Skies} or {spell:Wrath of Nature} is a good choice.
The {item:Coral Comb} is behind a sealed door, **just south** of the room. You can only open it if you have talked to Habdel/Ishina and don't have the addon yet.
The sealed door with the Coral Comb, south of the room

With the comb, go back the same way (to the **west**) to the area where you fell to the sea floor, below {npc:Captain Max}'s boat. Return to his boat and ask him to take you back to **Liberty Bay**. Then take {npc:Jack Fate}'s boat to Darashia ({key:hi}, {key:darashia}, {key:yes}).
Never take off the {item:Helmet of the Deep} underwater, or you will drown.
If you rented the helmet, return it to {npc:Captain Max} by saying {key:return} and you get your 5000 gp deposit back.
In Darashia, say {key:hi}, {key:comb} and {key:yes} to {npc:Habdel} (men) or hand the comb to {npc:Ishina} (women). You receive the first addon.
2. Gather the items for the second addon
The Turban (male) and the Veil (female) ask for exactly the same items. You can gather them before you start.
Loot from Quaras and {creature:Quara Scout|Quara Scouts}
Trade {item:Boots of Haste} with {npc:Haroun} (Blue Djinn Fortress) or {npc:Yaman} (Green Djinn Fortress)
Loot from {creature:Blue Djinn|Blue Djinns} and {creature:Marid|Marids}, or trade {item:Mystic Turban|Mystic Turbans} with {npc:Irmana}
Talk to {npc:Razan} in Darashia. Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:task}, {key:yes} and, after the explanation, {key:yes} again.

With everything in your inventory, say {key:ape fur} and {key:yes}, then {key:fish fins} and {key:yes}, {key:enchanted chicken wings} and {key:yes}, and finally {key:blue cloth} and {key:yes}. Razan makes you the turban.
Go to {npc:Miraia}, who sells drinks in the **south** of Darashia (Enlightened Oasis). Say {key:hi}, {key:outfit}, {key:task}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again.

With everything in your inventory, say {key:100 pieces of ape fur} and {key:yes}, {key:100 fish fins} and {key:yes}, {key:two enchanted chicken wings} and {key:yes}, and finally {key:100 pieces of blue cloth} and {key:yes}. Miraia makes you the veil.
With both addons you get the full Oriental outfit.
After you receive the comb addon you can no longer pick up another {item:Coral Comb} in the sealed room in Calassa.
